verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a developer tool with an AI Repository Agent, so turning plain language into commands is a fair question to ask of it. But the evidence only shows the agent performing repository actions directly (browse, edit, commit, pull, push) through conversation. Nothing shows it generating shell commands, and the pack documents no terminal or shell surface where such commands could run.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can describe what I want in plain language and have the tool generate the corresponding shell command
